trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of the 3-sentence proposition. Recomputed against the proof: d_q alpha = q^{-1} d alpha + (1-q^{-1}) Theta wedge L_xi alpha gives d_q^2 alpha = q^{-1}(1-q^{-1}) dTheta wedge L_xi alpha, matching the statement exactly. No trap in any of the ten categories.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: Separate flag (not a trap): the iff is slightly over-stated. q^{-1}(1-q^{-1}) = 0 iff q = 1 (q^{-1} = 0 is impossible), so the 'q = 1' branch is right; but the vanishing of dTheta wedge L_xi alpha does not require L_xi alpha = 0 unless wedging with dTheta is injective in the relevant degree. Suggest 'if and only if q = 1 or dTheta wedge L_xi alpha = 0', or state the Reeb-invariant form as the sufficient condition.
